turns.text: Hi, uh, yeah, I need to change my flight. It's the Dubai to London one on Friday.
I can help with that. First I need to verify your booking. Please give me your booking code and last name.
It's YY2K6N, Gad. Look, I'm gold status, so changes are free for me, right?
Thank you, Mr. Gad. I can confirm the booking, but I can't confirm any status benefit on this call, so the standard rules apply.
No, no, a previous agent promised me gold changes are free. He literally said that, I'm not making it up.
I'm sorry, I can't see that promise, and I can't waive the policy. Your booking was made four days ago, so a change costs a $75 Economy fee plus any fare difference.
Seventy-five dollars? That's crazy, gold means free. Can you just check again?
I checked, and I can't waive the fee based on a status I can't verify. I can set up a supervisor callback if you want to dispute it.
Uh, fine. So if I wanted to move to a later flight, what would it cost me?
It would be the $75 fee plus the fare difference for the new flight. Your flight stays as booked until you decide.
Okay. Put the supervisor thing in. And I'm not paying the seventy-five.
I've requested a supervisor callback about the status promise. Your SK214 flight stays as booked, and no change has been made.
